from solution import find_Parity


def test_issue_example_12():
    """Example find_Parity(12) == "Even Parity"."""
    # 12 = 0b1100 -> 2 ones -> 2 % 2 == 0 -> "Even Parity"
    assert find_Parity(12) == "Even Parity"


def test_issue_zero_even():
    """Parity of given number 0 is "Even Parity"."""
    # 0 = 0b0 -> 0 ones -> 0 % 2 == 0 -> "Even Parity"
    assert find_Parity(0) == "Even Parity"


def test_issue_one_odd():
    """Parity of given number 1 is "Odd Parity"."""
    # 1 = 0b1 -> 1 one -> 1 % 2 == 1 -> "Odd Parity"
    assert find_Parity(1) == "Odd Parity"


def test_issue_two_odd():
    """Parity counts 1-bits so 2 is "Odd Parity"."""
    # 2 = 0b10 -> 1 one -> 1 % 2 == 1 -> "Odd Parity"
    assert find_Parity(2) == "Odd Parity"


def test_issue_three_even():
    """Parity counts 1-bits so 3 is "Even Parity"."""
    # 3 = 0b11 -> 2 ones -> 2 % 2 == 0 -> "Even Parity"
    assert find_Parity(3) == "Even Parity"


def test_issue_seven_odd():
    """Parity of given number 7 is "Odd Parity"."""
    # 7 = 0b111 -> 3 ones -> 3 % 2 == 1 -> "Odd Parity"
    assert find_Parity(7) == "Odd Parity"


def test_issue_eight_odd():
    """Parity counts 1-bits so 8 is "Odd Parity"."""
    # 8 = 0b1000 -> 1 one -> 1 % 2 == 1 -> "Odd Parity"
    assert find_Parity(8) == "Odd Parity"


def test_issue_fifteen_even():
    """Parity counts 1-bits so 15 is "Even Parity"."""
    # 15 = 0b1111 -> 4 ones -> 4 % 2 == 0 -> "Even Parity"
    assert find_Parity(15) == "Even Parity"


def test_issue_sixteen_odd():
    """Parity counts 1-bits so 16 is "Odd Parity"."""
    # 16 = 0b10000 -> 1 one -> 1 % 2 == 1 -> "Odd Parity"
    assert find_Parity(16) == "Odd Parity"


def test_issue_255_even():
    """Parity of given number 255 is "Even Parity"."""
    # 255 = 0b11111111 -> 8 ones -> 8 % 2 == 0 -> "Even Parity"
    assert find_Parity(255) == "Even Parity"


def test_contract_valid_strings():
    """Result must be exactly "Even Parity" or "Odd Parity"."""
    # allowed literals are "Even Parity" and "Odd Parity"
    assert find_Parity(12) in ("Even Parity", "Odd Parity")
    assert find_Parity(1) in ("Even Parity", "Odd Parity")


def test_contract_returns_str():
    """find_Parity returns a string."""
    # 6 = 0b110 -> 2 ones -> "Even Parity" is a str
    result = find_Parity(6)
    assert isinstance(result, str)
